source: Fortnite Wiki Item Shop History/<Month> <day><suffix> <year> pages (fortnite.fandom.com, MediaWiki API; December 6th 2018 - February 27th 2019, Season 7's whole run, 84 days; February 14th 2019 from its Part 1 (the page is titled "... - Part 1"), the shop at UTC midnight), read 2026-11-16, the items and prices as charged that day (featured = the wiki's featured tiles, daily = its daily tiles, each item of a cycling tile (the wiki's ImageCycler) listed; the items of one tile carry {tile: n}, the same n for the day's items that shared the tile, and its callout as {banner}: "Pick your Style!" PickYourStyle, "Collect the Set!" CollectTheSet, "It's Back!" Back; other callouts (New!, the sales' "15% Off", "Selectable Styles!", "Select your Team!", "Gift Only!", "Unlockable Styles!") are left out). fnbr.co was not cross-checked. Each item is matched to 7.10's (CL-4667333) data by its display name and type (the wiki's Highrise Assault Trooper, Tower Recon Specialist and Brush Your Shoulders without their <small> markup, Chomp Sr without its period, its Haversting Tool typo read as Harvesting Tool). Only the cosmetics 7.10 has are kept, and a build is shown those its own data has: 7.00 (CL-4629139) all but the 40 of 7.10's own the shop sold (89 entries: Krampus, Crackabella, Tinseltoes, Red-nosed Ranger, Fishstick, DJ Bop, Sugarplum, Ark, Paradox and Lace, the Candy Cane wrap and the rest, read 2026-11-16 the same way); Season 7's later ones, Content Update v7.20's to v7.40's (Marshmello, the Ice Queen, Snowstrike...), are left out; Battle Pass Tiers, bundles, free (0 V-Bucks) items and Limited Time Offers / real-money tiles are left out too; on the days with no featured items kept (21 of the 84), the featured section is empty
